title: Beef Tacos with Mexican Twist
description: A twist on traditional tacos using outrageously garlicky beef and served with a mexican flair.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the cumin and chili powder and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until the flavors are fragrant.
Stir in the freshly squeezed lime juice and cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Warm tacos shells according to package instructions.
Assemble tacos by spooning beef mixture into shells and topping with chopped cilantro.
